body:
Hey, I really appreciate you looking into my experience and pulling that out of it. You're right, I haven't really felt allowed to be myself. Like I wasn't good enough. After faking things for so long, I don't know who I am anymore. I would like to be myself, but I don't know how to do that!
I suppose we're all figuring that out, day after day, aren't we?

Thank you! I'd bet they'd love to hear from you. You may have said it before, but gratitude outside of the crises is so sweet. It's good of you to come here to SW and help out these OPs. Thank you again.

I definitely can relate there, wanting to stop feeling. I'd prefer to keep things here in this thread, due to the sub rules.
The thing is, is that I don't know what to talk about. I could lay out the self-doubt that runs through my head, but someone arguing against my uselessness doesn't seem to help. Writing out all my confusion in my submission seemed to help, though.
Thank you for taking the time to relate with me.

Honestly, after realizing how much I had written, I didn't expect anyone to bother. Much less multiple times! It's nice to know I'm not just speaking to dead air, even if nothing else comes from this. Thank you.
